label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y pondrás el atrio alrededor, y darás el masaj de la puerta del atrio.
spanish: Y pondrás el atrio alrededor, y darás la cortina de la puerta del atrio.
grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated Hebrew lemma "masaj" with the Spanish common noun "cortina" for מָסַךְ (H4539, screen/hanging), and corrected the article to feminine agreement ("el masaj" → "la cortina").
